# PlayLight

> PlayLight (also styled Play Light) is a life management and productivity app by Light Technologies — a calm orb that helps you visualize and navigate your day with focus, protocols, goals, and memory of what you meant to do.

PlayLight is available at https://www.playlight.app. Contact: hello@playlight.app. Company: Light Technologies.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.playlight.app/): Product landing — download links and overview.
- [About](https://www.playlight.app/about): Story of Playlight — the orb, protocols, plans, and memory.
- [Support](https://www.playlight.app/support): How to get help, FAQs, and contact email.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.playlight.app/privacy): What data is collected, how it is used, and user rights.
- [Delete Account or Data](https://www.playlight.app/delete): How to request account or data deletion.

## Optional

- [Full LLM context](https://www.playlight.app/llms-full.txt): Concatenated markdown of the pages above for single-fetch ingestion.
